dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Oh my, fancy meeting you here! Out for a stroll again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm in the middle of some important business...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Huh. Aren't you a busy one these days? Still, running around like this all the time... Remember to take a proper break once in a while, you hear?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Swing by my place when you've got a moment. The Knights of Favonius sent over a bunch of stuff again, and there's some for you.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Just... Maybe not right now. I've gotta go sort out a little matter with the Lightkeepers.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: #See you next time, {NICKNAME}. Do remember to come pick up that crayon drawing Klee made for you.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I ran into Flins today. Could've had a good drink...
